never_do: Never open a second Fiverr account, for the company, for a brand, or for any reason. Fiverr: 'In order to buy and/or sell services on Fiverr you may have only one account.' Consequence: 'Any violation of this policy can lead to permanent suspension of the account(s) involved in this activity.' The plural reaches every account in the cluster.

Never log into the other founder's account on any platform for any reason. Upwork: 'You cannot log into someone else's account or let anyone log into your account and work or communicate on your behalf.'
Never share payment methods, withdrawal accounts, devices, browsers or IP between the two Upwork accounts. Linked accounts are flagged by device and browser fingerprint and by payment-method links.

Never front a US identity on an account operated from India. Upwork: 'The name on your account should be what you use to identify yourself in everyday life' and 'The address you provide should be your business address', with permanent suspension where information cannot be verified.
Never reopen a closed Upwork account with the same email. Upwork names that as a Terms of Service violation.
Never create a Fiverr agency before a third in-house member exists. The stated minimum is 3 team members.

Never route a marketplace conversation off-platform for payment or contact details. Fiverr requires all communication on the platform, and personal contact details inside a gig are an explicit denial trigger.
Never cancel an Upwork contract ourselves. Freelancer-initiated cancellations are a very strong JSS negative. Negotiate a reduced-scope close instead.
Never buy a review, coach a review, or accept an order for a deliverable that is not genuinely delivered. Order manipulation is an account-termination risk, not a warning.
Never claim production-scale metrics. Answer rate, booking rate and calls-at-scale are not measured. Latency is measured. State the method and the date, every time.
Never imply US bar admission or insurance licensure. Compliance framing is engineering, not legal advice.

Never mention Hanflux on Frankie's Upwork account: not in the profile, headline, overview, portfolio, catalog listings, proposals or messages. Frankie presents as Frankie Alicea, Oraya, licensed insurance producer. Founder directive 2026-09-14. accounts.tos_notes: VERIFIED, research/marketplace-expansion.md section 3.1 and 3.2. One account per person: 'In order to buy and/or sell services on Fiverr you may have only one account.' Prohibited purposes of multiple accounts include gaining a competitive advantage and bypassing a restriction. Consequence: 'Any violation of this policy can lead to permanent suspension of the account(s) involved in this activity', and for severe violations the decision 'cannot be reversed'. The only stated exception is a seller account plus a seat in a Team Account. Detection surface is shared IP, shared payment methods, behavioural signals and network relationships. A third-party reading that a registered company and its employee may hold separate accounts is NOT Fiverr policy and is not relied on. Fiverr agencies require a team of at least 3 in-house professionals (up to 9), are invitation-based, and are limited to five categories including Programming and Tech; orders, gigs, chats and reviews carry over on switching. Fiverr Pro acceptance is reported below 3% with a 2 to 4 week review, weighting off-platform credentials above Fiverr review counts. External promotion is explicitly permitted: 'Sharing a link to your Gig or profile is encouraged', including paid advertising on Facebook, Instagram and Google, but never with personal contact details and never moving communication off-platform.

accounts.tos_notes: VERIFIED, research/marketplace-expansion.md section 2.9 and 3.4. 'each freelancer can only create one agency on Upwork'. Agency Plus, about $19.99/month, is required to add team members and unlocks the ability to buy Connects without handing any over; it also gives unlimited members, a custom agency URL, competitor bid visibility and Upwork Chat Pro, with no cap on business manager roles. Joining requires an invitation from the owner or an agency administrator. 'all agency members can submit proposals' and 'Each proposal draws from the agency's collective balance of Connects', but 'Only business managers can accept an offer'. Members keep their own login: 'your account remains private and sign-in details must not be shared with the agency owner or any other party'. 'All contract earnings are paid to the agency's financial account on Upwork' and payments from agency to member are not protected or facilitated by Upwork, so the internal split needs its own written agreement. On agency closure, completed contracts count toward each member's own Job Success Score in their individual freelancer account.

accounts.tos_notes: BLOCKED, verified. research/marketplace-expansion.md section 3.2. Fiverr agencies require 'a team of at least 3 in-house professionals', an active presence in an eligible category (Programming and Tech qualifies), and demonstrated capacity for large-scale projects. The onboarding requirements page states 'Up to 9 team members are allowed. Required to add at least 3 team members'. Entry is invitation-based: Fiverr sends invitations to users meeting current standards, who then complete an application form, with a waiting list otherwise. Two founders is one short of the minimum, so this is a hard blocker today, not a soft one. It is also easily solved later by a third contributor. Do NOT attempt a second Fiverr seller account as a workaround: one account per person, permanent suspension of the account(s) involved.
